category5.design: Crash differential on h5_extended_fuzzer: it opens the input read-write and closes it, and closing a file whose persistent free-space managers hold free sections re-writes their section info through H5FS__cache_sinfo_serialize, where the extra loop iteration reads past the bins array (heap-buffer-overflow; checked locally with a generated file, the stock *_persist.h5 test files have no free sections).
